caveats: Measured, July (and one October) 2022. Each voltage step interleaves three drive configurations: AB (both electrodes, how the gate is operated), A alone, B alone. A single channel needs ~2x the AB voltage; never average them. Voltages are per channel.

Energies are the labels in the filenames, and some are known to be wrong: files named 14 kV ran at 13 kV, and one 13 kV log covers a 10 kV session (vault: blanking-run-metadata-mismatch). The gun's Anode_prog is the authority.
Sessions must not be pooled: the requirement drifts between sessions by more than it varies with energy (15 kV AB: 27.4 V on 22 Jul, 54.7 V on 26-27 Jul).

Transmission has the per-trial zero offset (the cup reads about -5 to -6 pA fully blanked) subtracted. Trials that did not reach their floor are drawn but give no V10: their offset is still on the falling edge.
Retracted claims not to be revived from these curves: V10 proportional to E^0.68, 'partition noise' mid-curve, and any conversion of volts to micrometres.
The curated 15 kV run drives channel B only, and the curated 14 kV file repeats the 13 kV acquisition; the 'sort out' 10 kV C60++ sweep is byte-identical to a curated one.
